purpose: Preserve the failed formal-publication attempt that exposed one remaining exact-byte boundary check and a masked execution-control exit status.

execution_control.failure: The live pre-model capture was recovery-equivalent to the locked boundary but had a different exact file hash because a terminal RQ audit row became visible. The model runner still required exact byte equality even though the formal builder already used the trusted manufacturing projection.

pipeline_failure.masked_status: The control step recorded run_status=1 but omitted exit $run_status, so GitHub displayed the step as successful and the missing control-gate sentinel was only exposed by the final archive step.

repair.runner_boundary_policy: Use exact equality by default and allow semantic equality only through the registered family-specific trusted projection, before any provider access.
repair.workflow_status_policy: Propagate the collected execution-control status as the step exit code.
